"""DCP-only oracle attribution and fixed covariance transport on cached pilot fields."""
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

import numpy as np

from analysis.render import runtime_env
from measure_noise_opening_stages import read_crops
from study_noise_local_transport import compare
from study_noise_neighbourhoods import ROOT,sha256,git


def projected(matrix):
    m=np.asarray(matrix,dtype=float)
    if m.shape!=(3,3) or not np.isfinite(m).all():raise ValueError('Finite3x3 covariance required')
    p=np.array([[.2627002120112671,.6779980715188708,.0593017164698620],[1,0,-1],[-.5,1,-.5]])
    return p@m@p.T


def same_profile_context(a,b):
    return a['profile_sha256']==b['profile_sha256'] and abs(a['source_kelvin']-b['source_kelvin'])<=1e-9 and a['calibration_applied']==b['calibration_applied']


def run():
    started=datetime.now(timezone.utc);base=ROOT/'docs/validation/raw'
    paths=[base/n for n in ('sonde-etapes-ouverture-bruit-v001-20261028T104746Z.json','prediction-locale-transport-bruit-v001-20261028T110349Z.json')]
    hashes=[sha256(p) for p in paths];pilot,prediction=[json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for p in paths]
    req_path=Path(prediction['request']['path']);native_path=Path(prediction['native']['path'])
    if sha256(req_path)!=prediction['request']['sha256'] or sha256(native_path)!=prediction['native']['sha256']:raise ValueError('Frozen prediction inputs changed')
    old_request=json.loads(req_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    old_native=json.loads(native_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'));covs={r['case_id']:r['covariance_camera'] for r in old_native['records']}
    tool=ROOT/'build-patch_noise/burst-tools/Release/iprProfileNoiseTransport.exe';tool_hash=sha256(tool)
    subprocess.run([str(tool),'--self-test'],check=True,env=runtime_env(tool),timeout=30)
    stamp=started.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ');work=ROOT/'build-patch_noise/profile-noise-decomposition'/stamp
    work.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False);fields=work/'fields.f32';cases=[]
    crops={}
    for path,item in pilot['native'].items():
        pixels=Path(item['pixels']['path'])
        if sha256(pixels)!=item['pixels']['sha256']:raise ValueError('Native crop changed')
        crops[path]=read_crops(pixels,item['record'])
    with fields.open('xb') as handle:
        for old in old_request['cases']:
            pair=pilot['records'][old['pair_index']];a,b=pair['paths'];roi=old['roi']
            ra,rb=[pilot['native'][p]['record'] for p in (a,b)]
            if not same_profile_context(ra,rb):raise ValueError('Pair changes profile context; cannot attribute to common DCP')
            if sha256(Path(old['profile']))!=old['profile_sha256']:raise ValueError('Profile changed')
            case={k:old[k] for k in ('case_id','iso','role','roi','profile','profile_sha256','source_kelvin',
                'baseline_exposure_ev','profile_exposure_compensation_ev','preserve_tone_curve_hue')}
            for name,path,stage in (('a',a,'pre_dcp_camera_rgb'),('b',b,'pre_dcp_camera_rgb'),
                                    ('fa',a,'post_dcp_rec2020'),('fb',b,'post_dcp_rec2020')):
                values=crops[path][stage][roi][64:192,64:192]
                case[name]=handle.tell();handle.write(np.asarray(values,dtype='<f4').tobytes())
            case['predicted_camera_covariance']=covs[old['case_id']];cases.append(case)
    request=dict(campaign_id='noise-profile-decomposition-freeze-'+stamp,schema_version=1,data_version=1,
        measured_at_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),fields=str(fields),fields_sha256=sha256(fields),cases=cases,
        policy='All18 cached center128 cases, no new RAW. Actual pre-DCP pairs and profile replay guard1e-7. Jacobian central differences h=1e-5 and half-step5e-6, no tuning. Global mean vs paired midpoint field; oracle J*actual residual vs three-node Gauss-Legendre path-averaged J. Predicted covariance remains frozen from iid RAW simulation. Midpoints use both real captures: attribution oracle, NOT mono-image predictor.')
    request_path=base/f'gel-decomposition-profil-bruit-v001-{stamp}.json'
    with request_path.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as handle:json.dump(request,handle,ensure_ascii=False,indent=1,allow_nan=False)
    print('FROZEN',request_path,flush=True);out=work/'native.json'
    subprocess.run([str(tool),str(request_path),str(out)],check=True,env=runtime_env(tool),timeout=600)
    native=json.loads(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'));by_id={c['case_id']:c for c in cases};records=[]
    methods=('oracle_global_jacobian','oracle_midpoint_jacobian','oracle_integrated_jacobian',
             'oracle_midpoint_half_step','predicted_global_jacobian','predicted_field_jacobian','predicted_field_half_step')
    for record in native['records']:
        c=by_id[record['case_id']];actual=projected(record['actual_working_covariance'])
        comparisons={method:compare(projected(record[method]),actual) for method in methods}
        records.append(dict(case_id=record['case_id'],iso=c['iso'],role=c['role'],roi=c['roi'],
            replay_max_delta=record['replay_max_delta'],comparisons_y_co_cg=comparisons,
            original_iid_prediction=next(r for r in prediction['records'] if r['case_id']==record['case_id'])['y_co_cg']))
    summaries={}
    for method in methods:
        ratios=np.array([r['comparisons_y_co_cg'][method]['sigma_ratios'] for r in records])
        summaries[method]=dict(min_sigma_ratio=float(ratios.min()),max_sigma_ratio=float(ratios.max()),
            median_sigma_ratios=np.median(ratios,axis=0).tolist(),median_abs_sigma_error=float(np.median(abs(ratios-1))))
        print(method,summaries[method],flush=True)
    if len(records)!=18:raise ValueError('Incomplete coverage')
    if hashes!=[sha256(p) for p in paths] or sha256(tool)!=tool_hash:raise ValueError('Tool/parent changed')
    now=datetime.now(timezone.utc);output=base/f'decomposition-profil-bruit-v001-{now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")}.json'
    result=dict(campaign_id='noise-profile-decomposition-'+stamp,schema_version=1,data_version=1,
        started_at_utc=started.isoformat(),measured_at_utc=now.isoformat(),completed_at_utc=now.isoformat(),
        parents=[dict(path=str(p),sha256=h) for p,h in zip(paths,hashes)],request=dict(path=str(request_path),sha256=sha256(request_path)),
        native=dict(path=str(out),sha256=sha256(out)),tool=dict(path=str(tool),sha256=tool_hash),records=records,summaries=summaries,
        runner_sha256=sha256(Path(__file__)),runner_source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),commit=git('rev-parse','HEAD'),
        sources={n:dict(sha256=sha256(ROOT/n),source=(ROOT/n).read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for n in ('tests/burst_tools/profile_noise_transport.cpp','src/profiles/CameraProfileEngine.cpp')},
        units='Camera and Rec2020 covariances; dimensionless Y/Co/Cg sigma ratios.',
        limitations='Pair midpoints and residuals use BOTH captures: oracle attribution, not deployable noise estimator or independent validation. Gauss-Legendre path replay targets the same pair and its agreement is a numerical identity check, not prediction accuracy. Finite differences and LUT/curve branch crossings limit local Jacobian validity. Frozen simulated camera covariance assumed spatially constant; averaging J*C*J^T omits spatial covariance contribution to whole-ROI mean removal. Residuals may contain motion or illumination variation. No new RAW decode, parameter optimization, production modification or final sealed burst access.',
        verdict='profile_transport_attribution_oracle_not_mono_image_validation')
    with output.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as handle:json.dump(result,handle,ensure_ascii=False,indent=1,allow_nan=False)
    print('RESULT',output,flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':run()
